title: Robocalls and robotexts - federal basics
facts: Federal law restricts many autodialed or prerecorded calls and texts, with requirements depending on the technology, recipient, purpose and consent.
Telemarketing robocalls generally face stricter prior-consent requirements than many non-telemarketing communications.
Consumers can revoke consent through reasonable means in circumstances covered by FCC rules.
Not every unwanted call violates the same federal rule, and exemptions or different standards can apply.
